revision_summary: Two timestamp errors to fix: the customer quote 'I have Michael has no credit at all...' is stamped at 02:22 in script_coverage[tax_credit_qualifier] and objections[0], but the transcript places it at 02:35 (02:22 is the rep's question 'Is that gonna be an issue for you at all?'). Correct both to ts=02:35, and use 02:22 only for the rep's qualifier question. Additionally: (1) rename/reframe the script_coverage section mislabeled 'tax_credit_qualifier' — it covers the credit_qualifier (670 score), not the tax_credit_disclosure; use 'credit_qualifier' as the section key and correct schema_reference. (2) Reclassify objections[0].type from 'cost' to a qualifier/DQ type — this is a hard qualifier gate per qualifiers.credit_qualifier, not a cost objection eligible for objection_inversion treatment. (3) Soften the confidence of the outcome_dispute and coaching_focus[priority=1] language — the schema explicitly marks stated-vs-pulled credit policy as unresolved/TBD with Kenny; Stage 3 should present the thin-file distinction as a flagged coaching/policy question, not assert with confidence that this is 'the single highest-leverage moment' or a likely lost deal. (4) Flag the two garbled ASR passages (00:40 and 01:35-01:44) as transcription-quality artifacts rather than presenting them as clean rep/customer dialogue in script_coverage. (5) Consider noting the intro at 00:11 doesn't match either the 'tesla' or 'standard' intro template — a third variant ('received a request for looking at solar') worth flagging for schema drift tracking.
